  File "/app/app/metrics.py", line 2, in error_rate
    return errors / total
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
history.root_cause_summary: error_rate divides by a total that is zero when there was no traffic
history.suggested_patch:
--- a/app/metrics.py
+++ b/app/metrics.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def error_rate(errors, total):
-    return errors / total
+    return 0.0 if total == 0 else errors / total
history.reviewer_note: 0.0 reads as a perfect score. Return None when total is 0 so the dashboard shows n/a.

fix.new: return None if total == 0 else ok / total
